items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Otis would be playing the first trumpet.

ctx.x: Would Henry Allen be playing the first trumpet?

Well, he was playing... No, I would say Red was playing first trumpet. Otis would be playing the first trumpet. And some... Well, I mean, it was intermittent. Some numbers Red would be playing first trumpet. But they did away with that first trumpet part, and one-thing-or-another, and they started marking the music, the arranger would start marking the music, "Henry Allen" or "Otis Johnson," "Charlie Holmes"... He'd mark the parts by the name. You didn't know what you was playing. I mean, no first or third or…
